title: One-Reference Material Retrieval: Code and Numerical Results
description: Version 2.1.0 preserves the 2.0.0 code and numerical evidence and adds the fixed-727-query Fabric reference-investment reanalysis, saved prediction subsets, replay script, numerical tables and English revision reports. Results are conditional and exploratory. This publication synchronization does not add training, inference or image acquisition. The compact GitHub distribution omits large binary ranking/score arrays; the full Zenodo archive retains them. No original photographs, model weights, adapted checkpoints, complete feature/pixel caches, manuscript PDFs, submission letters, author-confirmation files or private reviewer links are included. Source code is MIT; derived numerical data are CC BY 4.0. Third-party terms and the original dataset DOI remain unchanged.
